statement_map.email_excerpt: You reached out because leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not going out to them.

Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and after a test form submission you confirmed the email arrived and everything is now working correctly.
We explained that emails can sometimes land in spam, so it is a good idea to verify your sender domain, which you can do in the email domain section of Settings.
Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings (you mentioned you planned to do this the morning after our call).
